_comment: Copy this file to privacy.config.json and edit for your app. App identity (name, slug, colour, support email, privacy URL) is read from src/constants.ts — do not duplicate it here. Then run: node scripts/gen-privacy-policy.mjs. See store-listing/PRIVACY.md.
userContent: the recipes, meal plans, and shopping lists you create

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.purpose: optional; used for reminders you opt into. Denying this does not limit any other feature.

deletedImmediately: Everything removed with the account (list your app's user content here)
All app data cached on the device

retained.reason: they contain no information identifying you and therefore cannot be traced back to a deleted account
